title: A Non-Multiplicable Upho Poset Constructed from the Petersen Graph
summary: An upper homogeneous (upho) poset is a poset whose every principal filter is isomorphic to the whole poset. Fu--Peng--Zhang conjectured that every finitary upho poset admits a compatible left-cancellative, invertible-free monoid structure whose left-divisibility order coincides with the given order. We disprove this conjecture. For every vertex-transitive graph $G$, we construct a finitary upho poset $P(G,v_0)$ from walks starting at a fixed vertex $v_0$.
